# Getting help with Forma

Forma is one person's open-source project, so the quickest answer is usually
already written down.

- **How do I…?** The [documentation](https://openforma.web.app/docs) covers the
  whole workspace, and the [FAQ](https://openforma.web.app/faq) the questions
  people ask most. Both have search.
- **Is this supposed to happen?** Ask in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/waqarsyd/forma/discussions), under Q&A. A
  question does not need to be an issue first.
- **Something is broken, or a report came back wrong.** Open an
  [issue](https://github.com/waqarsyd/forma/issues/new/choose); the forms ask
  for what makes it fixable, including the version Settings shows under
  General.
- **An idea.** The Ideas category in Discussions, or the idea form among the
  issues. The [roadmap](https://github.com/waqarsyd/forma/milestones) is the
  milestones, and its text is section 6 of [docs/PRD.md](../docs/PRD.md).
- **A security problem.** Not in public: see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Anything else.** The [contact page](https://openforma.web.app/contact).

What changed and when is on the [changelog](https://openforma.web.app/changelog),
which has a feed.
